station.hearth_bench.note: Age I-II hand bench: knap, bind, forge rough parts

station.kitchen.note: built: right-click crafts from nearby chests

station.wright_bench.note: Age III: join iron and timber parts, press coin

station.smeltery.note: Age IV multiblock: pour molten metal into casts, like a Tinkers smeltery

station.steam_forge.note: Age V: boiler-powered forge for steel parts and engines

machine.assembler.note: Age VI: assembles major parts, speed tier by modules

station.fabricator.note: Age VIII: nanoalloy parts and top modules

forms.part: cast, forged or pressed at a station from raw material
forms.assembly: join a few major parts at a station (an engine, a transmission), never sub-components
forms.process: a machine or bench works one input into one output over time
forms.quick: simple everyday item; the crafting grid is allowed
